title: Progress Software WS_FTP Server versions prior to 2024.0.7 and 2025.0.4 on Windows may expose a user's password in…
description: Progress Software WS_FTP Server versions prior to 2024.0.7 and 2025.0.4 on Windows may expose user passwords in clear text to other administrators. This vulnerability could allow an administrator with limited privileges to obtain passwords and potentially escalate their access on the server.
